[P2] Reconcile the S3 fallback with the recorded design decision

The PR description explicitly decides that an undetermined location adds nothing to the prompt because Test connection reports it. This branch instead adds the failure reason to the prompt and blocked result, and the new test requires that behavior. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 7, “List the decisions that the task did not cover”: the actual fallback policy and its rationale are not presented for maintainer acceptance. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, reconcile the intended behavior, and obtain agreement on the actual decision.
